_about: List rates per million tokens used to reprice a recorded game's tokens on models that did not play it (evaluation/experiments/game_cost_reprice.py). Rows in Agents/llm_factory/pricing.py are the project's catalogue; the rows marked here with a source are models the catalogue does not price. write_factor: what a token written to the cache bills at, as a multiple of input (the catalogue's rule: 1.25 on Claude and GPT-6, 1.0 elsewhere).
